name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
steps: Stand with the kettlebell against your chest, hold its horns and extend one leg forward.
Brace your core, keep your working foot flat on the floor, and slowly sit your hips back and down on your standing leg.
Lower smoothly as deep as your mobility allows while keeping your extended heel off the floor.
Drive firmly through your standing foot to return upright, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep your entire standing foot planted flat rather than rolling up onto your toes.
Guide your working knee slightly outward over your toes so it does not cave inward as you stand up.
